From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: AppDev Summit — inference needs & next steps (Lighthouse AI)

Tom / Aisha — great meeting you at the AppDev Summit this morning. Quick recap from our booth chat so we stay aligned and can move toward a short POC if this looks like a fit: 

- Observed need: low-latency inference for real-time recommendation scoring (target p50 < 200ms, p95 < 350ms) for 10k RPS bursty traffic.
- Privacy requirement: customer PHI in inference payloads -> prefer VPC/on-prem routing and customer-managed keys.
- Scale target: initial pilot for one region (US-East), then multi-region in Q4.

Suggested next steps:
1) Quick 30-min tech sync with your eng team to validate SLOs and data path (I included Marissa to join for infra requirements).
2) We can spin up a 4-week POC (dedicated pool) with sample traffic and SLA testing — draft SOW attached.
3) If POC looks good, follow with a three-month reserved capacity plan and rollout.

I've attached a short draft SOW and a one-pager on our Private deployment options. If you can share a couple of windows this week or next, I'll get a calendar invite over.

Thanks again for the conversation — feels like a strong fit given your latency and compliance constraints.

— Marcus Lin
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com | (415) 555-0126

Attachment: redwood-poc-draft-sow.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)

Hi Marcus — thanks for the clear recap and the SOW. A few quick clarifying questions before we lock a time: 

- Pricing bands: can you share rough cost estimates for the 4-week pilot (dedicated pool) and the subsequent reserved capacity tiers? Ballpark numbers are fine.
- Data residency / encryption: we need to confirm support for customer-managed KMS/HSM and VPC-private control plane for PHI. Is that available for POC?
- Compliance: do you have SOC 2 Type II evidence and data retention/audit logs for inference requests?

CC'ing Aisha (VP Eng) — she will be our technical lead on the sync. We can do a 30-min call next Tue or Thu morning PT; we may need an early slot (~8:30–9:30am PT) to line up with our EU team later.

Also, can you confirm whether the pilot includes metrics export (Prometheus + traces) to our monitoring stack?

— Tom
Tom Walker
Head of Platform Engineering | Lighthouse AI
tom.walker@lighthouse.ai

- KMS/HSM + VPC: yes — our Private deployment supports customer-managed KMS and a private control plane in your VPC for POCs and production. We can enable it for the pilot.

- Metrics: we provide Prometheus metrics export and tracing hooks (Jaeger/OpenTelemetry) out of the box; we can export to your monitoring stack.
